materialPersonnelClosureGate.purpose: Prevent a material confirmed absence from being dismissed as an unresolved no-move before the current roster, depth/role replacement and governed Walters values have actually been exhausted.
requiredBeforeNoNumericMove: confirm the material availability transaction/status from current reliable evidence
inspect current depth/role evidence for the unavailable player and replacement role
enumerate every credible current replacement candidate
look up the locked Walters value of the unavailable player and every credible candidate
classify the replacement as one-for-one, committee, multirole or unresolved-after-complete-search
review M4 value-invariant committee eligibility where a committee exists
materialPersonnelClosureGate.unresolvedCaseAction: Every material confirmed absence that remains unresolved after the complete search must still be submitted through personnel-staging.json as a fail-closed case so the personnel ledger and research ledger receive durable evidence.
materialPersonnelClosureGate.taskCompletionRule: A scheduled Graham research task that discovers a new material confirmed absence may not report the case complete, unchanged, or no numeric move until the governed personnel workflow has durably recorded the case. If the closure search or workflow cannot be completed, report PERSONNEL REVIEW INCOMPLETE or PERSONNEL PRODUCTION BLOCKED instead of a substantive no-move conclusion.
durableCompletionRequires: active personnel ledger contains the new batch/event
active research ledger contains the personnel production batch
active current-numbers read-back reflects the governed result
new material personnel event contains the source-bound candidate lookup evidence generated by the closure validator

lookupEvidencePolicy.rule: Boolean lookup flags alone are not proof. The existing workflow performs and records full-registry lookups for the unavailable player and the union of every named credible candidate, using the source binding in player-values-access-v1.json. It records exact EA IDs, frozen Madden ratings, calibrated Walters values, lookup outcomes, registry blob/hash and actual check time. This is evidence only; it neither chooses a replacement nor grants numeric authority.
lookupEvidencePolicy.candidateCoverage: replacementCandidatesConsidered must include every candidate named in replacementCandidates, committeeCandidates, committee and replacementPlayer. Researchers must still discover credible candidates from real roster/role reporting; automated lookup cannot discover an omitted real-world role.
lookupEvidencePolicy.emptyCandidateRule: An empty candidate set cannot be called a completed search without replacementClassification=UNRESOLVED_AFTER_COMPLETE_SEARCH, a substantive noReplacementCandidatesReason and nonempty replacementSearchSourceRefs. Do not invent a candidate to pass validation.
lookupEvidencePolicy.missingValueRule: NOT_FOUND, AMBIGUOUS, IDENTITY_CONFLICT and VALUE_UNAVAILABLE are explicit lookup outcomes, never zero. Resolve identity conflicts before staging. A real missing calibrated value remains a valuation gap, distinct from an unperformed lookup.
lookupEvidencePolicy.committeeRule: Identical candidate values are only a lead for existing M4 eligibility review. They do not independently authorize a committee, workload weights, baseline exclusions, cluster treatment or a numeric move. Existing M4 and QB production authority remains unchanged.
lookupEvidencePolicy.historicalRule: Read-only audits may perform new lookups against preserved cases at the actual current time. They must never backdate a review, overwrite an old event, change an archived game or label navigation leads as verified role evidence. A historical numeric correction still requires the existing separate governed authority.

outstandingCaseReview.rule: During each scheduled information review, inspect unresolved material cases within that run's team/game scope, not just newly discovered absences. Missing closure proof, unnamed candidates, unchecked values and failed lookup identities are unfinished research, even when copied from an earlier sweep. Reuse source-valid documented lookups; research only missing or changed role/availability facts. Do not rerun unchanged numeric adjustments.
outstandingCaseReview.rolloverRule: At the new-week baseline, reconcile still-relevant prior-week unresolved absences with the active roster and current availability. Reuse traceable evidence as leads, but create current-week cases through existing staging with new event IDs; never copy prior-week numeric overlays or silently drop an unresolved absence because the new personnel ledger is initially empty.
outstandingCaseReview.caseDispositionRule: Record every in-scope unresolved case in the scheduled research sweep with caseKey, research state, evidence references and specific next action. If the required research is unfinished, use the existing BLOCKED_WITH_DURABLE_RECORD completion result as appropriate; do not call the case FAIL_CLOSED_AFTER_FULL_REVIEW. Keep unrelated completed research and eligible personnel cases moving in separate valid batches.
outstandingCaseReview.gameDayHandoffRule: Before using a personnel value as prior-game injury loss for Walters 90/10, verify final game-day relevance and completeness for both teams. An early-week report, absent overlay, green maintenance run or successful duplicate skip is not game-day coverage. Missing facts remain explicit and cannot be replaced with zero.

staging.taskRule: Scheduled Graham tasks discover and verify personnel facts, complete the material-personnel closure gate for every confirmed material absence, then submit a market-isolated staging batch even when the final result remains fail closed. The repository workflow owns numeric calculation and live-board mutation. Follow outstandingCaseReview for carried unresolved cases. The closure validator's --write mode attaches lookup evidence only to the local staging copy before the existing calculator persists it in new personnel events; it does not write a new production rating file.
